bead.title: Relational log conformance expansion
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The relational family is still only exercised as a relational-reconnect backend in the current conformance files, so the log-class contract in TD-001 is not enforced for the rebuilt-from-log path.
ROOT CAUSE
`crates/pqueue-postgres/tests/relational_conformance.rs:1-24` and `crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/relational_conformance.rs:1-29` explicitly scope the relational suites to core/reconnect behavior and state that log scenarios do not apply yet.
PROPOSED FIX
Expand the relational family test harness to cover the log conformance class once the recovery seam lands, and ensure the relational backends pass the same replay/snapshot recovery expectations as the other log-bearing families.
NON-SCOPE
backend recovery plumbing, docs wording cleanup, and the `pqueue-b59f4897` prerequisite implementation.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestRelationalLogConformanceClassGreen` runs the log-class scenarios against the relational family after rebuild-from-log recovery is in place.
2. `TestRelationalReplayBranchReadAsOf` proves the relational family can serve replay-from-log, branch-at-position, and read-as-of expectations required by TD-001 once enabled.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --test conformance` and `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite --test conformance` pass with the relational family included in the log-class coverage.
4. `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
